main_text.l: כְּמָרִים m.p. Sacrificuli atrati, Sacerdotes, gentiles & idololatrici.
מִכְמוֹר מִכְמָר m. Rete, Rete jaculum.
מִכְמֶרֶת, מִכְמֶרֶת f. Idem, plur. מִכְמָרִים.
כִּנְמָא Chal. Hujusmodi, Hunc in modum, In hanc sententiam.
כָּנַס Colligere, Congerere, Comportare, Congregare. Pihel כִּנֵּס idem. Hithpahel הִתְכַּנֵּס Colligere se.
כנע Hiphil הִכְנִיעַ Depressit, Proftravit, Abjectum, Humilem reddidit. Niphal הִכָּנִיעַ Depressit, Demisit, Abjecit se, Depressus vel Abjectus fuit.
כְּנַעַן Canaan, nomen proprium viri & terra, quae mercatura celebris. Inde est Negotiator, Mercator. כְּנַעֲנִי Cananaeus, Mercator: כְּנַעֲנִית Cananaea.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are copied from a damaged scan and may be imperfect; the entry כְּנוּה and the Hiphil/Niphal forms are the least certain. Page is heavily stained at the edges; no marginal notes are printed.
